references.text: Moses gathers Aaron and his sons at the entrance to the tent of meeting as preparation for their consecration, just as the Lord had commanded.
Moses gathers the assembly of Israel and conveys the Lord's message to them, using the same introductory formula about what the Lord has commanded.
Moses does as the Lord commands him and gathers the assembly at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
Moses tells the people that this is what the Lord has commanded them to do, using the same linguistic formula.
The phrase 'this is what the Lord has commanded' is used when Moses conveys God's message to the people.
Moses and Aaron do as the Lord has commanded them, a recurring theme of obedience to the Lord's commands.
Moses carries out everything exactly as the Lord had commanded him, demonstrating faithful obedience to God's commands.
